new_production_instrumentation.what: Config-borne `latent_capture` diagnostic. When on, _select_topk_indices (which already slices the resident fp8 latent + per-128-block scales for the absorbed scorer) dumps, per (tp_rank, request, DS layer), the SHA256 of each prompt-prefix slot's resident fp8-latent bytes + its per-block scale bytes. This is the table-free absorbed-selection ROOT identity (selection = deterministic fn of query + cached fp8 latent bytes; no materialized signatures exist post-TokenLabelTable-deletion).
new_production_instrumentation.capture_safety: Eager decode only: no-op unless forward_mode.is_decode() AND not torch.cuda.is_current_stream_capturing() (host copy/SHA is illegal under CUDA-graph capture, and the prompt-prefix slots are only host-readable on the eager forward). Off by default; the hot path pays one getattr when the flag is unset. Dump dir defaults under os.getcwd() (worker CWD = repo root; /dev/shm is NOT shared across sandboxed TP workers) with SGLANG_DS_LATENT_CAPTURE_DIR override.
